claim:lotka-volterra.hypothesis: Integrating the predator-prey reaction network (prey birth, predation, predator death, predator reproduction) through simbio yields both species staying strictly positive and the prey oscillating with repeated peaks over t in [0, 40].

narrative.question: Does viva-simbio expose the simbio chemical-reaction-network ODE engine as a process-bigraph process that integrates an Antimony model and emits real species trajectories?
